environment: Ubuntu WSL, Go 1.26.0, PostgreSQL 16.14, isolated migration-backed schema per test

checks.name: reproduced_role_change_race
checks.detail: With the former separate advisory locks, sole-administrator recovery completed successfully while promotion of another administrator remained uncommitted.

checks.name: serialized_recovery
checks.detail: Both sole-active and zero-active recovery now wait behind administrator role changes; after a concurrent promotion commits they return unavailable without changing password, block state or audit. Five repeated PostgreSQL runs passed.

checks.name: successful_recovery
checks.detail: Both recovery modes succeeded when eligible; PostgreSQL state confirmed password replacement, session and voice lease revocation, SESSION_REVOKED reason, one SFU outbox row and one audit event.

checks.name: backend_suite
checks.detail: go test -json -count=1 ./... with both PostgreSQL test URL variables: 670 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed; focused go vet passed.

limitations: Recovery tests use synthetic replacement hashes at repository level; operator CLI and HTTP authorization remain separate checks.
Queued SFU revocation does not prove a connected media participant was removed; QA-10 covers that gate.
